title: Great on mobile, desktop can be improved
body: Great app, looks extremely good and the premium lifetime plan is definitely worth it!
author: Antouto

title: Perfect for the price
body: I find the app to be well-organized and functional. I finally have a solid app to personalise and track my habits. The ideas of daily, weekly and monthly habits are thorough enough for my needs. My next step would be to be able to plan more precisely my habit behaviours, like, for example, creating calendar events in order to define when and what I will be doing. I can, of course, do this independently from the app, but I would like somehow these events to relate to my habits so I can easily manage repeating events by using the app.
author: ArcaGraphy

title: Alles was man braucht
body:
Die App biete alles was man braucht um sich neue Gewohnheiten anzueignen oder Laster loszuwerden. 

Dabei ist die Anwendung strukturiert und klar gehalten. 

Perfekt für die guten Vorsätze im neuen Jahr 👍
author: Dan the Dev

title: Great, but would love a native desktop app
body: The best habit tracker I managed to find. UX is great and well developed! Works well on desktop but sometimes its quite cumbersome to have to click so much to edit. Well worth the lifetime license!
author: Lucio Fontana

title: Such a useful app!!!
body:
Tried a number of habit apps. All of them did not work for me. They were either too childlike or too cumbersome.
This one is fast.⏱️ I use this app every day in my business. It is one of my favourites and helps me getting more productive.
The app offers notes and links – which is great, because for new habits I sometimes have to look at "cheat sheets". However, for ordinary habits this feature is nicely hidden. As a result the app stays slim.😀
It offers a variety of options. Great, because every user has different needs.‼️
What's more, the app is beautifully designed.❤️I enjoy using it. Makes fun.

(To the developer: I encourage you to write code for other purposes as well. You seem to be very gifted for this trade.)
author: Fz31cc

title: Great and app with a simple and easy to use interface
body:
Please add a small Widget, that shows the daily progress circle + percentage. And please please please, add Apples dark grey as background Color!!!!! 

 Update: Great, that it’s now possible to have the percentage circle only! The only thing that’s left for me to be perfectly happy is a dark grey background option in the widget (just as in Apples calendar widget for example)

Update 2: Thank you very much for adding a grey background option!!! Now the widget is a perfect fit for me! 👍😃
author: BernardoLXXVIII

title: Great app!
body:
